capabilities.capability: SELECT scan, projection, predicates, ordering, LIMIT and nonzero OFFSET
capabilities.reason: Native regression and performance tests pass; no pinned PostgreSQL 18 differential result is recorded.

capabilities.capability: INNER/LEFT joins, grouped aggregates, HAVING and bounded spill sort/hash execution
capabilities.reason: Operator regressions and memory/spill gates pass without reference execution.

capabilities.capability: Non-recursive and iterative recursive CTEs with bounded depth and rows
capabilities.reason: CTE semantics and 54000/54001 bounds have local tests only.

capabilities.capability: Scalar/correlated subqueries, EXISTS, IN, ANY/ALL and derived LATERAL INNER/LEFT apply
capabilities.reason: Local binder/executor tests pass; table-function and first-FROM LATERAL gaps remain unsupported.

capabilities.capability: UNION, INTERSECT and EXCEPT with ALL/DISTINCT semantics
capabilities.reason: Local result, NULL and ordering regressions pass without live reference capture.

capabilities.capability: Named/inherited windows, rank/offset/value functions, aggregate FILTER and ROWS/RANGE frames
capabilities.reason: Bounded in-memory/spilled window tests pass; PostgreSQL 18 differential rows/types are absent.

capabilities.capability: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE RETURNING, ON CONFLICT and MERGE
capabilities.reason: Atomic candidate and command-tag regressions pass; client/reference replay is not run.

capabilities.capability: Numeric/decimal, character/text and bytea scalar behavior and wire mapping
capabilities.reason: Scalar, cast and NUMERIC wire regressions pass without differential reference execution.

capabilities.capability: Date, time, timestamp/time zone, interval and UUID
capabilities.reason: Local parsing, storage and wire mapping tests pass; full PostgreSQL temporal edge corpus is not run.

capabilities.capability: Arrays, enum evolution and domains
capabilities.reason: Catalog/storage/index/wire regressions pass without a reference server.

capabilities.capability: JSON/JSONB values, equality, casts and common functions
capabilities.reason: Typed JSON tests pass; ordering and PostgreSQL's complete JSONB operator surface are not claimed.

capabilities.capability: Implicit/explicit casts, comparison/arithmetic operators and common built-ins
capabilities.reason: Binder/evaluator tests pass for the declared subset; complete PostgreSQL built-ins are not claimed.

capabilities.capability: Schema/table/column/constraint/index/sequence/view/materialized-view DDL
capabilities.reason: Dependency, rollback, reopen and Catalog regressions pass; unrepresented clauses fail explicitly.

capabilities.capability: Roles, grants/revokes, ownership and Manage bypass
capabilities.reason: Deny-by-default RBAC and ownership tests pass without PostgreSQL role differential execution.

capabilities.capability: MVCC Read Committed statement snapshots and concurrent unrelated writers
capabilities.reason: Visibility and multi-writer regressions pass without differential anomaly replay.

capabilities.capability: Repeatable Read, Serializable SSI and read-only DEFERRABLE
capabilities.reason: SSI/read-set/anomaly regressions pass; PostgreSQL 18 differential schedules were not run.

capabilities.capability: Savepoints/subtransactions, AND CHAIN and failed-transaction recovery
capabilities.reason: Engine and ReadyForQuery I/T/E regressions pass without external differential execution.

capabilities.capability: Row/index/table locks, FIFO waits, cancellation, timeouts and deadlock victim selection
capabilities.reason: Deterministic lock manager tests pass; timing behavior was not compared with PostgreSQL 18.

capabilities.capability: VACUUM, ANALYZE, visibility reclamation, WAL checkpoint and crash recovery
capabilities.reason: Fault-injection/reopen tests pass; PostgreSQL storage format and PITR are not claimed.

capabilities.capability: Queryable pg_catalog and information_schema virtual relations with privilege filtering
capabilities.reason: Projection/join/filter/OID tests pass; pinned DataGrip/PostgreSQL result capture is absent.

capabilities.capability: PostgreSQL v3 startup, verify-full TLS policy, SCRAM-SHA-256 and ParameterStatus
capabilities.reason: Protocol/auth regressions pass; pinned external client TLS execution is missing.

capabilities.capability: Simple/Extended Query, prepared statements, Describe, suspension, Sync/Flush/Close
capabilities.reason: Codec and E2E regressions pass; psql/pgJDBC/DataGrip runtime evidence is absent.

capabilities.capability: Bounded atomic COPY text/CSV IN and OUT
capabilities.reason: Multi-batch, rollback and codec regressions pass without pinned psql/JDBC execution.

capabilities.capability: CancelRequest, NoticeResponse, LISTEN/NOTIFY and idle NotificationResponse
capabilities.reason: Cancellation/notification tests pass; external client behavior has not been run.

capabilities.capability: PL/pgSQL blocks, labels, loops, conditions, RAISE/ASSERT and exception handlers
capabilities.reason: Compiler/VM regressions pass; complete PostgreSQL language parity is not claimed.

capabilities.capability: Dynamic EXECUTE, INTO/STRICT/USING, record/ROWTYPE and bounded cursors
capabilities.reason: VM/cursor spill tests pass without reference procedure execution.

capabilities.capability: Row/statement triggers, INSTEAD OF views and eligible top-level procedure transaction control
capabilities.reason: Trigger/procedure rollback and stack tests pass; unsupported trigger variants remain explicit.

capabilities.capability: REINDEX scopes, LISTEN/UNLISTEN/NOTIFY, DEALLOCATE ALL and DISCARD ALL
capabilities.reason: Local atomicity/session cleanup tests pass without external client differential execution.

capabilities.capability: RAII query grants, bounded chunks/spill/iterators and explicit 54001 frame stacks
capabilities.reason: Paired performance, 10M scan, cancellation/drop and 128 KiB release-stack tests passed.

capabilities.capability: Physical CREATE/ALTER/DROP DATABASE SQL commands
capabilities.reason: The v2 cluster owns real database boundaries, but physical database DDL is not exposed through SQL.

capabilities.capability: Table inheritance, partitioning and generated columns
capabilities.reason: These accepted PostgreSQL clauses are outside the declared DDL subset and fail explicitly.

capabilities.capability: PostgreSQL extensions and C extension ABI
capabilities.reason: OrdaDB does not load PostgreSQL C extensions or claim ABI compatibility.

capabilities.capability: Foreign Data Wrappers
capabilities.reason: External databases use signed connector helpers, not PostgreSQL FDW APIs.

capabilities.capability: Physical/logical replication and hot standby
capabilities.reason: No replication protocol or standby product claim exists.

capabilities.capability: Two-phase commit, WAL archive and point-in-time recovery
capabilities.reason: Transactions and checkpoints are durable, but 2PC/WAL archive/PITR are not implemented.

capabilities.capability: SECURITY DEFINER, event/constraint/transition triggers and autonomous transactions
capabilities.reason: The procedural subset rejects these security/trigger/transaction behaviors explicitly.
